rows.en: Please, leave that to my crew.
You'll do it?
After all, every one of my folks would gladly risk their lives for mankind's freedom and peace.
But… your opponent is former SIDO Director Sakomizu… no, Steel Emperor Zephas, you know?
What do I care! Takeshi, Hayato, Shiro, Kotaro, Goro, Ichiro, Jiro, and then…

Understood!

In any case… we'll leave the assault team to you! However, should you fail…

What are you saying?

If you're afraid of failing, you can't do anything! We always fight believing we'll win!

If you've got time to worry about that, I'd like you to concentrate your forces properly so Takeshi and the others can get inside easier.

Mr. Tachibana is right… We'll do our best as well!

Director…
Very well… We will now launch an all-out attack on the Space Fortress Naager…
…It's begun!
Steel Emperor Zephas has begun his invasion!
What!?
Director! The Ultra Garrison will sortie immediately!
The enemy's coming at us with everything they've got! Stay sharp! Got it?

Heh heh heh… Foolish Earthlings! Today is your final day…

Steel Emperor Zephas of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager begins his all-out attack! My Alien Legion and the BF will give their full cooperation to his invasion of Earth.

As you command…

To make sure they obey Emperor Guillotine's orders, I shall drain the Earthlings of every drop of their blood and turn them into fellow vampires!

Our ambition to conquer the Earth will surely succeed…

Heh heh heh… I'm counting on you!

Once that happens… Steel Emperor Zephas will become a nuisance too. But the time has not yet come… Go! Dracula!!

This is finally the last decisive battle!

The BF has thrown in every monster we've ever beaten! U7, we can't let our guard down!
U3, find the BF's headquarters! Steel Emperor Zephas has finally made his move. Be very careful.
Yes, sir!
If anything strange happens, both of you contact U6 right away! Understood?
Roger!
Daisaku, be careful.
Don't worry, Marie! This charm will protect me.
Heh heh… I hope so.

Heh heh heh… Foolish Earthlings! I'll make today your final day…

Steel Emperor Zephas of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager begins his all-out attack! Our Iron Mask Party will also throw in its entire strength and give its full cooperation to his invasion of Earth.

Yes, sir!

We'll begin the attack immediately!! The Earth will belong to our Iron Mask Party…

Heh heh heh… I'm counting on you!

Once that happens, Steel Emperor Zephas will become a nuisance… but the time has not yet come! Go! King Deviler!!
Ken, do you read me!? Ken…!

The Iron Mask Party's robots have launched an all-out attack!

Since Steel Emperor Zephas has started moving, they must have formed a joint front with the Iron Mask Party!
What!?
Ken, don't do anything reckless!
Deviler has thrown in every Iron Mask Party robot we've ever beaten! We can't let our guard down!
Damn it… I'll smash them to bits!
A holiday…?
Yes… Mr. Tachibana decided it, apparently!

He probably did it to settle everyone's nerves before the final battle…

But there's no time for us to rest! Fuuma has begun its invasion of the entire galaxy… Is nothing really happening on Earth!?
Yes, sir! I've just finished my patrol.
But it's strange, isn't it? The Fuuma whirlwind is raging across the whole galaxy, right?
There's no way Fuuma would overlook the Earth! We need to be on high alert…
Planet Metro, Planet Beat… and Planet Lohn have been wiped out.
And also… Kitz and Uru, who were in your class at the training academy, have been killed in action…
Kitz and Uru…!?
Both of you… please, take care of your lives!!
Yes, sir…

Kitz and Uru… they were both good guys!

I'll avenge them! I swear I'll defeat Fuuma!!

But to do that…

you'll have to cross swords with that Apfaron… and Atefarina too, won't you?
Yes… The Battle Fleet Nation Naager is lurking in Fuuma's shadow!
Yes, sir. I'll be very careful!
This will be a fight to the death, you know?
We're prepared…
Don't die, Shaider…
Fly, fly! Giant Robo!
Red Baron!!
Giant Robo!? So the all-out battle has finally begun?
Red Baron!? So the all-out battle has finally begun?
Aww, what a bummer! Retsu's not even here…
Can't be helped… He's got his duties as a Space Sheriff too…

But… it's been a while since I saw the horsies.

Hey… why did you stop riding?
[HERO4]…? What's wrong? Asking something like that all of a sudden…
[HERO2], you loved riding, didn't you? Ever since we were little, we went to the riding club with our dads, right? Remember?
Yeah, of course I remember… Including how you'd always get thrown off and cry.
Heh heh… I was just feeling kind of nostalgic… just a little.

…………

It's okay, really…

I know why you stopped riding, [HERO2]…

You're worried it'll make me remember my dad… right?

Hehehe… I'm totally fine!

I mean… I think about Dad all the time anyway. I'd never forget him… not for a single day.

So…

you don't have to worry about it, [HERO2]. You can go back to riding, the thing you love…

[HERO4]…

The real reason… I stopped riding…

is because of Satoru…

I thought that if I started riding again, it might make you remember Satoru…

Huh…!?

…………

Big brother…
Security Team has arrived!! We'll back you up right away.
Planet Gaute in the M47 Great Orion Nebula… and Fuuma's invasion forces are at Planet Moss…
What!?
Planet Shoot in the M1 Crab Nebula, and Planet Cain… completely wiped out…
Wiped out…?
Fuuma's onslaught just keeps growing stronger.
At this rate, the whole galaxy will fall to Fuuma!
But I wonder why? Why aren't they attacking the Earth?
Yeah… That space fortress is keeping quiet too! They must be plotting something.
It seems to have become the all-out battle we predicted…
Yes, sir… We've sent sortie requests to the Science Patrol and MAT as well. I expect they'll join the battle shortly.

uncertain: U13704: 迫水元SIDO長官 = Kiichi Sakomizu (glossary), the hero's father; rendered 'former SIDO Director Sakomizu'. SIDO kept as acronym.
U13705: Tobei's list uses given names: Takeshi (Hongo), Hayato, Shiro, Kotaro, Goro, Ichiro, Jiro.
U13710/U13711: Kitakura cuts in on the Director's sentence; narration row continues her report.
U13715: 宇宙人兵団 rendered 'Alien Legion'; BF団 = 'the BF' per glossary.
U13741/U13771/U13773: planet names romanized (Metro, Beat, Lohn, Gaute, Moss, Shoot, Cain); 恵星 read as 惑星.
U13742: キッツとウル romanized Kitz and Uru.
U13762/U13765/U13766: パパ rendered 'dad'; 'our dads' for パパたち.
U13768/U13769: Satoru = Satoru Hinata (glossary); [HERO4]'s 'お兄ちゃん' seems to refer to Satoru as her brother, rendered 'Big brother…'. Relationship not established in this batch.
omissions_kept: U13769: 'Big brother…' kept without saying whom she means (Satoru or [HERO2]), as in the source.

new_names.why: only 鉄面党員 in glossary
Unicorn codes, not in glossary (U7 is)
